I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, so it will come up in future sessions: all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, and code never calls Celery directly (no `.delay()`, `apply_async()` or `send_task()`). No earlier memory conflicted with it.

I also searched the repo and found no current references to `celery` or an `enqueue` definition, so nothing needs changing yet. The rule will apply to code added from here on.
